Candy Crush Saga is great I use to play it long time ago. Love it! This is my all time favorite game. I just LOVE playing this so much! It's better than any game I've played in the last 15 years. I really would give it 10 stars...if I could.

Gameplay is the same as it's always been, but after playing the around 350 levels one thing is clear: this game turned from a fun little game to cure boredom into nothing more than a predatory money greedy trap. The only real challenge is an ever decreasing number of moves, which even with an extremely powered up start through win streak boni as well as activated power up are not nearly enough to beat the levels, trying to force the player to buy gold at some point to progress.

I've been going thru this game f2p and it's ok for most of the levels but every time you get to the end of a string of levels, it jumps up in difficulty and is nearly impossible to complete. I haven't bought anything yet but it always shows an option to buy things. It's not f2p friendly but I refuse to buy anything. So far I've been on one level for two days straight now. Stopped playing a while ago and am updating to reflect that. What starts as a decent enough time killer very quickly becomes more frustrating than fun. I'd rather play a game where the levels had been crafted to be challenging and engaging than one where the design brief was to keep victory just one or two microtransactions away. Finally, speaking entirely personally, I find the design aesthetic too saccharine to be particularly appealing.
The game is awesome but complete app is closing and we are losing our win streaks... please fix the issue

Because of these recent improvements, I've never progressed this far and played this game for so long each day. I want to keep playing because of the battle royale feature and how simple it is to get gold. I really adore the ability to view advertisements for other moves. I dislike two things, though: sometimes the levels set me up for failure with what drops down, even if it's random, and I've never landed on those stars for the booster wheel, which is very absurd.

I agree with the new reviews this game is getting. I am stubborn so I have been on the same level for over a month now!! Boosters are a joke. You can only get the wheel and the streak booster. I make sure I log in every morning to get those. I contacted the developers about this and was told "new and better" opportunities would be coming. That was a while ago. I may just stop playing because I refuse to spend money to PLAY A GAME!!!

A mindless game to be sure, but sometimes you just need something to keep you busy whilst listening to a podcast. The mechanisms so far haven't ever been too tough, you get enough boosters as you play and I love that I'm not sitting through a hundred ads. Quite a bit of luck involved

It's really a good game, to play anytime, anywhere. when ever you are free. But unable to play mystery quest, when I am online. This isn't good, this should be improve. Lives from friends is limited to 20/day only which is not good. I'm decreasing rating.

Honestly the game is phenomenal I've been playing for a long time. About 5 yrs now. Granted, yeah new account because well certain issues arrived but that's alright. The latest updates to candy crush make it more addictive than ever! Entertainment bordering on obsession!! Horribly addictive but there are worse habits in this world. I have played daily for 4 years and it is still my favourite game for whiling away time. Even though some levels are infuriating, do not start paying for boosters. Just be patient and tough it out 😉

Game was cool at first now I have lost interest. These retarded nightmare hard levels uncalled for. The way you guys have this algorithm set up to clear 200 items with 20 moves is stupid as it gets. They have actually made the higher levels just as satisfying to play and less frustrating. Good job candy crush!

Once, my favorite game. But, now that I've hit higher levels. I can't spin the wheel myself to receive my daily free gift.
